data.description:
## Description
**What**: Add Design C hybrid inline signal declaration to dso:story-decomposer: per-story emits_signals and consumes_signals fields carrying {canonical_name, surface, semantic} (plus detection on the consumer side), and a post-draft signal_manifest reflection block that aggregates every declared signal across the drafted story set.
**Why**: The deterministic critic (draft-3) and the preplanning fan-in gate (draft-4) both consume these structured fields; the original f360 failure mode was unstructured signal coupling that no gate could read. This story produces the structured substrate.
**Scope**:
- IN: emits_signals/consumes_signals field schema in the decomposer agent contract; the detection sub-field on consumer declarations; the post-draft signal_manifest reflection block aggregating declared signals; documentation of the new fields in the agent spec.
- OUT: the critic's three checks (draft-3); the heuristic post-pass (draft-5); the preplanning fan-in gate (draft-4); sprint/implementation-plan changes beyond reading signal_manifest.

## Done Definitions

- A drafted story carries an emits_signals field whose entries each contain canonical_name, surface, and semantic ← Satisfies: sc-2
- A drafted consumer story carries a consumes_signals field whose entries each contain canonical_name, surface, semantic, and detection ← Satisfies: sc-2
- The decomposer emits a post-draft signal_manifest reflection block aggregating every emits_signals and consumes_signals declaration across the drafted story set ← Satisfies: sc-2
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic, including a fixture asserting the signal_manifest aggregates a producer and a consumer declaration ← Satisfies: sc-2

## Considerations

- [Schema-coherence] The surface and detection sub-fields are the values draft-3 anchors against canonical_surface in the contract doc; keep the field names stable.
- [Self-reference] These fields live in the dso:story-decomposer agent the orchestrator dispatches; changes must remain backward-compatible with decomposer outputs that predate the field.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO plugin maintainer, I want the story-decomposer to declare per-story emits_signals and consumes_signals inline plus a post-draft signal_manifest, so that cross-skill signal couplings are captured structurally at draft time.
